requirements.requirement: The system must successfully ingest a realistic NPI API response structure via provider_detail_service without schema validation errors.
The system must extract credential fields (e.g., provider credential string) from the NPI response and pass them to the scoring logic.
The system must extract taxonomy code arrays from the NPI response and pass them to the scoring logic.
The system must extract license-related fields (e.g., state license or identifier fields) from the NPI response and pass them to the scoring logic.
The system must compute a credential completeness score using the extracted NPI fields and return a normalized score value.
The system must include the credential completeness score in the evaluate_care_facade response payload.
The system must include a component breakdown (e.g., credential, taxonomy, license contributions) in the facade response.
The system must produce identical scoring outputs for identical NPI input payloads across repeated test runs (deterministic behavior).
The system must correctly handle NPI responses containing multiple taxonomy entries without failure and include them in scoring.
The system must correctly handle NPI responses with partial credential data (e.g., missing credential string but present taxonomy) and still compute a valid score.
The system must return a valid default or degraded score when credential-related fields are entirely missing from the NPI response.
The system must not throw unhandled exceptions when the NPI response contains unexpected additional fields or ordering differences.
The system must fail gracefully and return a structured error response when the NPI payload is malformed or cannot be parsed (exception path).
The system must fail gracefully and return a structured error or fallback response when provider_detail_service returns no data for a given NPI (exception path).
The system must verify that the end-to-end flow from provider_detail_service through scoring logic to facade response completes within acceptable test execution time thresholds.
